AccessChannel.description:
How the contacts left the platform: the employer's cabinet, the company's ATS over the API,
or a webhook payload sent to the ATS right after acceptance.

Achievement.description: One record of the FSP registry snapshot (architecture §7.2).

aberrant.description: Person-fit flag of the answers (`l_z` below −2).

needs_confirmation.description: «Требует подтверждения»: the person-fit flag and integrity events together.

seq.description: `current.seq` of the item being answered (protects against double submits).

secret.description: The key itself, shown once: `Authorization: Bearer fsp_live_…`.

name.description: What the key is for, e.g. «Huntflow».

AssessmentRecord.description: One test session: the outcome without the tasks shown or the answers given.

person_fit_lz.description: Person-fit statistic `l_z` and whether it flagged an aberrant pattern.

oneOf.description: Video recording summary and integrity events; the video is not part of the export.

test_strength.description: Position of θ inside the measured grade band, 0..1.

needs_review.description:
«Требует подтверждения»: an aberrant answer pattern (person-fit) together with integrity
events — leaving the test or pasting. Sessions without proctoring data fall back to the
person-fit flag alone.

offers.description: What the candidate may do next right away (step down after a fail, upgrade after a confident pass).

oneOf.description: `None` when the session ran with proctoring off.

AtsCandidate.description: Who the event is about. Before acceptance: the anonymous code and category only.

code.description: Anonymous code shown to employers, e.g. `K-7F3A2C`.

id.description: Platform id for `GET /integrations/candidates/{id}`; after acceptance or application.

AtsCandidateProfile.description: Full profile after the candidate accepted an invitation or applied to the company.

updated_at.description: Latest status change; the polling cursor.

candidate.description: Before acceptance — anonymous code and category; after — also `id`.

next_since.description: Cursor for the next call; `null` when the page is empty.

verified.description: Confirmed by the test or FSP achievements, not only declared.

AttemptKind.description: The intent behind an attempt, which drives the next allowed action.

strength.description: 0..1 strength of the verified profile (test, FSP, freshness).

score.description: 0..100 fit to the need, when `need_id` is given.

display_name.description: Only when the candidate chose to show it.

test_strength.description: Position inside the grade band, 0..1 (comparable across different adaptive tests).

oneOf.description: `None` when the candidate hides FSP data; `score.has_history = false` when there is none.

How the test behind the current category was proctored; `None` for tests taken without
proctoring. Never carries the video.

contact_access.description: Which companies received your contacts and on what basis.

company.description: Hidden unless the candidate allows showing company names.

verified.description: Confirmed by the test or the FSP registry.

Category.description: A category is the unit employers browse: specialization × grade.

stack_match.description: Mean must-skill coverage of the category's candidates, 0..1.

requested.description: Grade is among the requested ones.

oneOf.description: Specialization the next test will be in (current category or the survey).

next_change_at.description: When a grade change becomes possible, if it is blocked by the cooldown now.

required_for.description: Registration of these roles requires the document.

applies_to.description: Roles that may grant the document at all (`POST /me/consents`).

ContactAccessEntry.description:
One line of the candidate's «Кто открывал ваши контакты»: the company and the legal basis.
The employee, IP and browser stay in the audit log and are not part of this view.

company_name.description: `None` when the company has since deleted its account.

index.description: Index into the achievements slice passed to [`fsp_score`].

seq.description: Number of already answered items; send it back with the answer.

format.description: File format; a new number means an incompatible change.

consents.description: Every grant and revocation: document version, time, IP and User-Agent.

Decision.description: Final classification once the session stops.

oneOf.description: Grade band θ̂ falls into (`None` below the junior cut).

aberrant.description: `l_z < aberrant_lz`: inconsistent pattern, result needs review.

next_attempt_at.description: For `pending`: when the next attempt is due.

Direction.description: Top-level IT direction ("отрасль" in the survey).

Disclosure.description:
Name, contacts and links to the full profile. Present only after the candidate accepted the
invitation or applied to the company's vacancy.

events.description: Up to 50 events; the session keeps the first 500.

at.description: Browser time of the event; clamped to the session's lifetime.

duration_ms.description: How long the candidate was away (`tab_hidden`, `window_blur`).

weight.description: Effective weight after renormalization; 0 when the feature does not apply.

contribution.description: Points out of 100: `100 × weight × value`; contributions sum to the total.

achievements.description: Snapshot from the registry (architecture.md §7.2). An empty list is a valid state.

oneOf.description: Score for the candidate's specialization; "Нет данных ФСП" without history.

document_id.description: Id of the current version from `GET /api/v1/consents/current`.

HiringOutcome.description: «Компания отметила: собеседование» — a stage the company's hiring system reported.

reason.description: Reason the company gave; visible to the candidate.

shortlist_url.description: Page of the need with the shortlist in the employer cabinet.

notes.description: What was assumed because the text did not say it.

Industry.description: Business domain of past experience — a soft matching signal, never a category.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the inbound API for the ATS, e.g. `https://…/api/v1/integrations`.

IntegrityEvent.description: What the browser reports while the test is running.

response_rate.description: Share of answered (accepted or declined) among non-withdrawn invitations.

hiring.description:
Hiring stages reported by the company's ATS (`POST /integrations/outcomes`): how many
invitations and applications reached each one.

ItemView.description: What the candidate sees. Contains no answer key.

options.description: Displayed options for choice kinds, empty otherwise.

access_token.description: Same token as the `fsp_at` cookie, for Bearer clients and Swagger.

outcomes.description: Stages the company's hiring system reported.

slug.description: Business domain of past experience — a soft matching signal, never a category.

title.description: Vacancy title in the ATS; the first line of `text` if absent.

text.description: Vacancy text as is: the parser finds specialization, grade, stack, salary and format.

oneOf.description: Overrides the salary range found in the text.

description.description: What the team does and whom it needs; also used for text relevance.

reason.description: Shown to the candidate. Up to 500 characters.

at.description: When it happened in the ATS.

strength.description: 0..1 strength of the verified profile (test, FSP, freshness).

score.description: 0..100 fit to the need, when `need_id` is given.

oneOf.description: Primary grade: the first one in the title, else in the text, else from experience.
Hint for the survey only — the category always comes from the test (M-1).

Place.description: Serialized as slugs; also accepts places as numbers (`1`, `"2"`) from the registry.

visible.description: Shown in employer search at all.

show_name.description: Full name on the anonymous card (contacts still need a grant).

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is the stable identifier the UI switches on.

document_id.description:
`consent_required`: the current version of the consent document to grant first
(`POST /api/v1/me/consents`).

ProctoringBadge.description:
Employer-facing proctoring mark of the test behind the current category. No session id and
no link: the video stays out of reach until and after «Принять», like the contacts (V-2).

left_test.description: Times the candidate left the test tab or window.

oneOf.description: Consent text for the checkbox of the proctoring step; `None` when `mode = off`.

consent_granted.description: The candidate already holds an unrevoked grant of this version.

ProctoringSummary.description: The candidate's own view of a session's proctoring.

chunks.description: Video chunks received, about 10 seconds each.

delete_after.description: The video is deleted after this moment.

purged.description: Already deleted: retention passed or the consent was revoked.

skills.description: Self-declared skill slugs. Test- and FSP-confirmed skills are added by the system.

outcomes.description: Stages the company's hiring system reported after acceptance.

contacts_available.description: Accepted invitation or own application: `/employer/candidates/{id}/contacts` will answer.

parsed.description:
Recognized values to prefill the profile form; nothing is saved to the profile until
the candidate confirms it with `PUT /candidate/profile`.

file.description: PDF up to 10 MB with a text layer.

reasons.description: Strongest positive reasons, at most four.

contact.description: How the candidate can reach the company (shown in the invitation).

max_expectation.description: Drop candidates whose expectations exceed this.

in_current.description: Matches the current filters; pinned candidates stay listed even when they don't.

skill.description: Display name of the requested skill.

matched_by.description: Candidate skill that earned the credit (the same skill or a similar one).

confidence.description:
0..1: share of the evidence that points at this specialization, damped when the
evidence itself is thin.

oneOf.description:
Choice made on the proctoring step. Omitted while proctoring is optional, the test runs
without video and is marked so.

claimed_grade.description: The grade the candidate expects to confirm with the test.

self_assessment.description:
Self-assessment per topic, 1–5. Only a starting hint for the adaptive test, never a score.
Keys come from the client, so the map keeps std's DoS-resistant hasher.

TestPlan.description: Which topics and templates a test for `(spec, grade)` would emphasise, for the T-4 demo.

focus_templates.description: Template ids boosted because their skills overlap the requested stack.

samples.description:
The same plan rendered for two candidates: same templates and difficulty, different
numbers, code and answers — a leaked instance does not help the next candidate.

templates.description: Template ids under this topic, ordered by information at the grade's cut.

WebhookEvent.description:
Body of every webhook delivery. `id` repeats the `FSP-Event-Id` header: deliveries are
at-least-once, so the receiver deduplicates by it.

secret.description:
Signing secret, present only right after creation or rotation. Store it in the ATS:
it is not shown again.

secret_hint.description: The secret itself is shown once; afterwards only its beginning.

previous_secret_valid_until.description: After a rotation the previous secret also signs deliveries until this moment.

tags.description: API для ATS работодателя. Доступ — только API-ключом компании: `Authorization: Bearer fsp_live_…`, cookie и JWT здесь не принимаются. Лимит — 120 запросов в минуту на ключ. События приходят вебхуком (тело — схема `WebhookEvent`, подпись — заголовок `FSP-Signature: t=…,v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + "." + body)`), здесь — опрос, профиль кандидата после согласия, этапы найма и импорт вакансий
